label: L=3 sequences, first copy step after <DEL> (outputting token 1), when input/first token is d/c/u/w/f
explanation: Fires only at t=4 in length-3 sequences: the step right after <DEL>, where the input is the fed-back first original token and the model outputs original token 1. Never fires in the original phase, at the delimiter, at any other copy step, or in any other length. Within that slot (~8.6% of L=3 sequences fire) it is selective for the first token: d is strongest (about 42% of mass, includes the max activations), then c, u, w, f; n, o, a, q, v weakly. Digit-containing sequences are suppressed (86% of mass has no digits), and higher activations go with letter outputs. Even with the token list, about half of the predicted steps stay inactive, so the remaining selectivity (which depends on tokens 1 and 2) is not captured.

scorecard.summary: Graded preference over the current input token (most: d, w, u, c, f, n; least: 2, r, 3, b) and the second original token (most: b, g, e, y, 0, a; least: x, d, u, 3); timing cues that raise it most: L=3 & t=4, L=3, t=4.
